svg.title: Kuromatsu
svg.desc: The Kuromatsu black-pine bonsai logo on concrete, next to the project name and its promise: a personal AI agent in Go that runs a 1-bit LLM inside its own binary on a 1 GB VM.

g.text: PERSONAL AI AGENT · GO · 1 GB RAM
黒松 · black pine — resilience in extreme conditions
A personal AI agent that runs a 1-bit LLM
inside its own binary — on a 1 GB VM.
